map.依据 CMC(l:c) 色差公式计算标准样与批次样之间的色差，常用于纺织印染的色: Computes the colour difference between a standard sample and a batch sample with the CMC(l:c) formula, commonly used for pass/fail colour difference judgement in textile dyeing and printing. Default CMC(2:1), lightness tolerance l=2, chroma tolerance c=1.
map.📖 查看「色差 ΔE(CMC) 评估 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Colour Difference ΔE(CMC) Assessment Usage Guide"
map.CMC(l:c) 色差：ΔE_CMC = √((ΔL ÷ (l·S_L))² +: CMC(l:c) colour difference: ΔE_CMC = √((ΔL ÷ (l·S_L))² + (ΔC ÷ (c·S_C))² + (ΔH ÷ S_H)²), where ΔL, ΔC, ΔH are the lightness, chroma and hue differences and S_L, S_C, S_H the corresponding weights (computed from the standard sample Lab values); common parameters l:c = 2:1 (more tolerant of lightness difference, for textile dyeing and printing) or 1:1 (stricter on chroma difference, for coatings); ΔE_CMC not exceeding the tolerance (commonly 1.0 or 1.5) is judged pass.
map.CMC(2:1) 为纺织印染常用色差公式，比 ΔE*ab 更贴近人眼视觉，可接受: CMC(2:1) is the colour difference formula common in textile dyeing and printing; it is closer to human vision than ΔE*ab, and the acceptable threshold is usually taken as 1.0
map.输入 CIE L*a*b* 值（D65/10° 测色条件）；l 增大对明度差异更: Enter CIE L*a*b* values (D65/10° measurement condition); increasing l makes it more tolerant of lightness differences
map.色差合格线依客户/产品而定，本工具阈值可自定义，结果供配色与质检参考: The pass line for colour difference depends on the customer or product; this tool's threshold is customisable and the results are for reference in matching and quality inspection
map.📚 深度解析：色差 ΔE(CMC) 评估: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Colour Difference ΔE(CMC) Assessment
map.印染大货与标样色差合格判定：按客户来样容差（常见 1.0~2.0）判读批量是否可: Pass/fail judgement of colour difference between bulk production and the standard sample: read whether a batch is acceptable against the customer's tolerance (commonly 1.0~2.0).
map.配色打样多方案视觉一致性比对：同一标样多个配方打样，量化色光差异择优。: Visual consistency comparison of multiple matching recipes: sample several formulations against the same standard and quantify the colour differences to pick the best.
map.染料配方调整后色光偏移归因：由 ΔL/ΔC/ΔH 分量判断偏深偏浅、偏艳偏暗或偏: Attribute the shade shift after a dye recipe adjustment: use the ΔL/ΔC/ΔH components to judge whether it is too dark or too light, too bright or too dull, or off-hue.
map.活性黑浸染批次色差复核: Reactive black exhaust dyeing batch colour difference review
map.标样与批次 L*a*b* 分别为 (25.1,0.3,-0.2) 与 (26.4: Standard and batch L*a*b* are (25.1,0.3,-0.2) and (26.4,0.1,-0.5) respectively; CMC(2:1) gives ΔEcmc=1.4, below the customer tolerance of 2.0 so it is judged acceptable; ΔL=+1.3 runs dark and ΔH is slightly blue, so the dye concentration and shade can be fine-tuned.
map.CMC(l:c) 与 CIELAB ΔE*ab 有何区别？: How does CMC(l:c) differ from CIELAB ΔE*ab?
map.ΔE*ab 对各方向等权，与人眼视觉不一致；CMC(l:c) 对明度、彩度、色相: ΔE*ab weights all directions equally, which is inconsistent with human vision; CMC(l:c) weights lightness, chroma and hue separately (commonly l=2, c=1), is closer to actual visual tolerance, and is the colour difference standard the textile industry recommends.
map.l 和 c 一般取多少？: What values of l and c are normally used?
map.纺织印染常用 CMC(2:1)，即明度权重 2、彩度权重 1；对深色或特殊要求可: Textile dyeing and printing commonly uses CMC(2:1), that is lightness weight 2 and chroma weight 1; for dark colours or special requirements it can be adjusted, but it must be agreed with the customer in the contract.
map.结果能直接作为交货依据吗？: Can the result be used directly as the basis for delivery?
map.可作为内部色差判读与打样择优参考；最终交货以客户封样、合同容差与实验室实测为准，: It can serve as an internal reference for colour difference reading and for choosing among recipes; final delivery is governed by the customer's sealed sample, the contractual tolerance and laboratory measurement, and does not replace a formal test report.
map.CMC(l:c) 色差公式由英国染色家协会（SDC）提出，对明度、彩度、色相差异: The CMC(l:c) colour difference formula was proposed by the Society of Dyers and Colourists (SDC) of the UK. It weights lightness, chroma and hue differences separately, is visually more consistent than ΔE*ab, and is the mainstream standard for colour difference judgement in the textile dyeing and printing industry.
map.输出 ΔL/ΔC/ΔH 分量与方向: Outputs the ΔL/ΔC/ΔH components and direction
